body:
Source: GitHub issue #680 (bug, false-green, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 91d2fba0: packages/merge-forecast/lib/signals.mjs:99,146,196,231,270, lib/forecast.mjs. `(ticket.scope ?? []).some((g) => globMatch(g, f))` yields an empty file set for tickets with no scope, scope: [], or a scope that matches zero repo files. All conflict signals return 0, and `pairScore` returns score: 0 and verdict: PARALLEL with no warnings or gate failures. The forecast certifies maximum fan-out having analyzed no files.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/merge-forecast`: `bin/merge-forecast.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/forecast.mjs` (runForecast, computeWaveWidth), `lib/signals.mjs` (pairScore, walkTree, globMatch), `lib/reachability.mjs` (parallelEligiblePairs, topoWaves, mergeOrder). Tests: `npm test -w packages/merge-forecast` from the worktree root. Note: existing tests in `test/forecast.test.mjs` may pin `no scope -> 0`; update any test that pins the false-green behavior.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/merge-forecast/lib/forecast.mjs`: in `runForecast()`, inspect each ticket in `tickets`. If `!t.scope || !Array.isArray(t.scope) || t.scope.length === 0`, push warning `ticket "<id>" has no scope defined`. If `t.scope.length > 0` but `repoFiles.filter((f) => t.scope.some((g) => globMatch(g, f))).length === 0`, push warning `ticket "<id>" scope matches 0 files in repo`.
2. In `packages/merge-forecast/lib/forecast.mjs`: when scoring pairs in `runForecast`, if either ticket `a` or `b` has an empty/unmatched scope, treat the pair as non-parallel (verdict: 'SEQUENCE', score: 1.0 or signal: 'unknown-scope' / 'unscoped') so that unscoped tickets are not falsely certified for parallel dispatch in `firstWaveWidth` or `scheduleWidth`.
3. In `--json` and text output, ensure `warnings` array contains the scope warnings.
4. Documentation: update `packages/merge-forecast/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/merge-forecast.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/merge-forecast.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A ticket with no scope emits warning `ticket "<id>" has no scope defined`. verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/empty-scope-warning.test.mjs`
- AC2 A ticket with scope matching zero repo files emits warning `ticket "<id>" scope matches 0 files in repo`. verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/empty-scope-warning.test.mjs`
- AC3 Pairs involving an unscoped or zero-match ticket are treated as SEQUENCE and excluded from parallel wave width. verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/empty-scope-warning.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing test suite passes with updated expectations. verify: `npm test -w packages/merge-forecast`
- AC5 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "has no scope defined" packages/merge-forecast/README.md docs/tools/merge-forecast.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/merge-forecast.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #682 (--co-change-limit >= 1) or #681.
title: merge-forecast: warn on empty or zero-match ticket scopes and treat unknown-scope pairs as SEQUENCE
